input.summary:
West hall bath is still dark (28 of 28 floor cells at light 0) in build.nbt: runParts refuses every write into the shell-carved air of the room, including my lantern.
parts/room-20.mjs now has one standing lantern `g.set(40, 11, 56, ...B.lantern(false))`, which is refused by the lock; the scratch test with the lantern put in by hand gives min 8, 0 dark.
The room also still fails FIT ("hallway to nowhere") because the designer's fit-out was refused, and that is not mine to fix.
left: Light not in the real build: runParts' lock refuses room-20's writes into the shell-carved air (parts-report.json: west hall bath REFUSED 1 at 40,11,56 lantern air). Fix needs the shell to leave the bath's air unclaimed, or the lock to allow a room part to write its own box's air; that is outside the lamplighter's remit (shell/build.mjs).
Verified only on a scratch copy (build.nbt + one lantern via load/set/save): min 8, mean 11.6, 0 dark, 0 dim. The real build.nbt still reads 0 dark, so the room is not lit yet.

The lantern line in parts/room-20.mjs is kept on purpose: it is refused on every make.sh run (noisy, but it is the intended light) and lands once the lock allows it. The import of B from the build library is added at the top of the file.

FIT still reports 1 issue (hallway to nowhere at 40,11,54) because the bath's fit-out, a tub and basin, was refused by the same lock; the designer must re-add it once the shell releases the room's air.

Standing lantern chosen over a ceiling-hung one: a hung lantern at y16 leaves the far corners at level 6 (too dim), so the floor lantern against the west wall is the one that clears all 28 cells. The lane x41..42 from the door to the tub stays clear.

waste.what: Found by hand that the room's light is blocked: I had to read parts-report.json and then build a scratch copy to learn whether the lantern would light the room at all.
waste.cost: about 4 tool calls, 2 make.sh runs and one scratch load/set/save script
waste.tool: mcd room should report per cell whether a lamp can be written (lock or shell-owned air) before a rebuild, and should be able to try a candidate light on a scratch copy without a rebuild (e.g. mcd room --try 'lantern@40,11,56').

waste.what: Worked out the lantern's light level from the distances by hand while choosing between a hung and a standing lantern.
waste.cost: a few mental passes over 28 cells
waste.tool: mcd light --try, which computes the level of a candidate lamp on each cell and prints the min, so the placement choice is one call rather than arithmetic.

companions.role: room designer (the designer who owns parts/room-20.mjs)
companions.task: re-add the bath's fit-out (tub, basin, washstand) once the shell releases the room's air, and check the hallway-to-nowhere fit issue with the lantern in place.
leave the west hall bath's air unclaimed by the shell, or carve the bath as an explicit room-owned box, so the room part can write its own light and fit-out.
